_note: Plain-English notes shown in the online app's 'Update ready' card. Newest first. Add an entry with every release.

notes: Cooking mode shows the ingredients and amounts each step uses, so there's no scrolling back with messy hands.
Set your usual dinner time in Settings and the Today card says when to start.
Changed your mind after 'Shuffle'? There's now an Undo.
The planner avoids repeats from the last 3 weeks and suggests meals you loved more often.
New households are asked about allergies on first use.
Budget mode no longer swaps in something your household avoids (e.g. bottled lemon juice if you avoid sulphites).
Small recipe fixes for little ones' portions, and more security tightening.
Safety review: baby portions now use full-fat yoghurt, squashed edamame and soft (not crispy) chickpeas, beansprouts are always cooked through, and eggs for little ones are always fully set.
A warning shows when shop-bought foods make a little one's portion salty, and for babies under 6 months.
Fixed five recipes that were missing a step when you're not cooking for little ones.
Updates now wait for you: a blue ! on Settings means a new version is ready, with what's new.
The app checks for new versions whenever you switch back to it.
Done shopping moves ticked items into 'Bought this week', so the list shows only what's left and what it'll cost.
Once tonight's dinner is cooked, the Today card asks how it was.
Calories now show on the Today card, week and recipes. Tap a name for protein and the full breakdown.
Every recipe's method has been rewritten step by step, starting with the chopping and prep.
